notes.title: Update Alpha2.4b631
notes.notes:
[h2]Greetings!
[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44307817/064a3fdf09ecf870fc65edba1fdaa15d4b58cf55.png[/img]

[h2]This update includes several changes.[/h2]
Details of the update are below.

[h2]Version:Alpha2.4b631[/h2]
Changed: Inventory Icon Highlight Color
Hotfix:
Fixed: Drop Placement System
Fixed: Dropped specific item from inventory was not using gravity
Fixed: Loaded House Item was not placed correctly
Fixed: Loaded House Item was not turned on Kinematics

Added: Forest Park Area
Added: A Safe House at Forest Park
Added: Some lights around Touge Area
Added: Boss Building (for next major update)
Changed: Enemy Raider's health
Chnaged: Delivery Package Class
Hotfix:
Fixed: Streamer System

Added: Antialiasting Quality Level Setting
Added: New Craft Recipes
Changed: Item Icons for resources 
Changed: Melee Weapon Animation for Bat / Machete / Hammer
Changed: Auto Turret will turn more smoothly
Changed: Graphic Quality Level changed to Medium as Default
(High and Ultra Quality will use TAA)
Hotfix:
Fixed: Auto Turret was shooting walls when enemy was hiding behind a wall
Fixed: Machete has wrong collider inside the weapon
Fixed: Antialiasting Setting was not working correctly
Fixed: Default Camera was using TAA --> Now FXAA is default
Fixed: Localization for Japanese
Fixed: Localization for German
Fixed: Horde Enemy doesn't move toward to Tower
Fixed: Hundgun Animation
Fixed: ScorpioD Animation
Fixed: Camera stayed at wrong position after exiting a specific car

[h3]With each update, we plan to add buildings and dungeon-type buildings to locations you've already visited, so stay tuned.[/h3]

[h3]Thank you for all your supports.[/h3]

notes.title: Update Alpha2.1b521.1
notes.notes:
[h2]Thank you for waiting for a long time.[/h2]

This was partly due to a major change in my daily life, but now that it has been resolved, I would like to continue updating the Stable version (Default) and Latest version as usual.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44307817/5eed00b19d558e4fd33a85f24f0f4a570dbcd4d7.png[/img]

[h2]Alpha2.1b521.1[/h2]
This update took some time because we had to change the enemies, rework the basic mechanics, and change the entire system.

Additionally, it took time to implement tower defense mode, which is one of the key elements of this game.

Along with the addition of elements, we also expanded the area.

With each update, we plan to add buildings and dungeon-type buildings to locations you've already visited, so stay tuned.

Details of the update are below.

Ver:Alpha2.1b521.1
Added: Display operation keys on screen
Hotfix
Fixed: Trailer Side Parts were attached to wrong parts
Fixed: Trees Colors in new area
Fixed: A desk at Ayana's house has no colliders.
Fixed: A Road has no colliders
Fixed: Shop Area Adjusted at Base3 Camp

Ver:Alpha2.1b521
Added: Localized Interface
Added: New Area
Added: BaseCamp Winny Center
Added: Quest Manager Jean
Added: 6 new Quests
Added: Add translations to all documents
(Spanish, German, Chinese, French, Japanese)

Changed: The version display is now the same in all languages.
Changed: Visual Environment
Changed: Vehicle Size Adjusted
Changed: Start Location is Changed
Changed: Display a popup when collecting EMIT
Changed: Display a popup when collecting Old Currency
Changed; Changed the restart time of sub quests that can be repeated.
Hotfix
Fixed: Ammo System
(Fixed an issue where some extra bullets were being discarded when reloading)
Fixed: Sound Setting was not working correctly
Fixed: A6 Area Terrain Fixed
Fixed: Rader Distance for Quests
(Now Quest markers are now displayed regardless of distance)

Changed : Replace Enemy AI with new AI System 2.0
Added : New Type Enemy
Added: Tower Defense Mode

Once again, thank you for your support.

notes.title: Update Alpha0.113.0219a
notes.notes:
The latest update adds new items and new recipes for crafting.

This update includes some fix.

[h1]Changelog[/h1]

[h2]Added[/h2]
[list]
[b][*] 86 New Items
[*] New Recipes for Crafting
[*] Hotbar Slot for Spawning Nakama (Your Alley/ Partner) [/b]
[/list]


[h2]Changed[/h2]
[list]
[b][*] Safe Room's save file location changed
[*] Recipe can now be selected from Categories
[*] Hotbar Slot can now be used with Q key[][/b]
[/list]


[h3]Fixed[/h3]
[list]
[b][*] Crafting System
[*] Recipe was showing high level Recipes
[*] Player was stuck at specific point[/b]
[/list]


[b]The crafting system has been significantly changed to a category selection type menu.[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44307817/4a4f512e2a2a94a5c09e5bf0eb1f8bde11c972a4.gif[/img]

[h3]Little Game Tips[/h3]
[olist]
[b][*] When EMITs are low, collect them from soulless humans wandering around residences and crematoriums.
[*] If you get stuck while driving, don't rush and try to escape using the F2 key (this is a temporary measure)[/b]
[/olist]

[b]We plan to implement fixes not included in this update in the next small update.[/b]

notes.title: Update A0.101.1109a
notes.notes:
Hello Saviors!

This latest update adds some new feature: New Compass system, New Rader system, new Sub-Inventory for Junk.
We added a new Pickup Truck. This vehicle can be driven even on slight slopes.

With this update, we have reviewed the save file.

Once you start playing New Game, your safe house decorations and luggage will be automatically transferred.

[b]If you are playing from a previous version, please place all items in your inventory in the safe house and save them once.
[/b]

[h3]New Rader System[/h3]
A radar has been added to make it easier to see the location of quests and shelters. We also made sure to emit a light into the sky so that people can see the location of the evacuation center at night.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44307817/0677c1740e7208b6279384558e2ec417c4f9c68c.gif[/img]


In conjunction with the creation of new areas, we are currently working on reworking existing areas. This will be provided as the next update.

For a more comprehensive list of updates included in this release, please refer to the complete changelog below.
We wish you a Happy Thanksgiving day full of joy and happiness.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44307817/b5108ec858d6ab46d153d5bcd8a9dcd688b6bc4e.gif[/img]

[h1]Changelog[/h1]


[h3]Added[/h3]
[list]
[*]New Compass System 
[*]New Rader System
[*]New Sub-Inventory 
[*]Town Center Markers are now enabled by default
[*]Home and UncleG location Marker is now enabled by default
[*]Sell/Buy Junk items by specific person
[*]Added a new Pickup Truck 
[*]Two save files
[*]Added another route to JPT evacuation center where driving was difficult due to steep slope
[/list]


[h3]Changed[/h3]
[list]
[*]Replace old compass system with new system
[*]Some icons have been changed due to the introduction of Radar
[*]Change the engine sound of some cars
[*]Changed the behavior patterns of some bosses
[*]Updated documentation
[*]Improved bat animation
[/list]


Fixed
[list]
[*]Quest Indicator doesn't disappear on certain quests
[*]The BGM of the title scene continues to play during the movie
[*]The ground in the B7 area was transparent
[*]Some crafting menus were creating different items
[/list]

(Sub-Inventory is still a trial addition, so the final specifications are expected to be different.)


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44307817/ede83e23098e8b761b132ff1d22011c048d547db.gif[/img]


We are lacking in feedback from players, and we will take any feedback seriously and use it to improve DR, so please feel free to write to the community page.

notes.title: Hotfix
notes.notes:
[b]Greetings.[/b]

New version includes these hotfix. 

[list]
[*] UncleG Quest can't finish because of skipping Quest Trigger. 
This problem currently occurs if you go to the crematorium without accepting Quest from UncleG.

[*] Changed the options menu to a simpler format.　Made it easier to adjust.

[*] The car select menu can now be selected only from the keyboard. We plan to improve this.

[*] We have reviewed the quest restrictions and made them easier to accept. Allows the player to choose which quest to take. The story and special quests remain the same.
 
[/list]


Note: We are currently working on brushing up new areas in parallel with fixes.


If you have any feedback or requests, please leave them in the discussion section.

thank you.


Studio Mastashion

notes.title: Hotfix
notes.notes:
[b]Greetings.[/b]

Here is a small fix for some issues that came up yesterday.
This caused some players an inconvenience.

[list]
[*] UncleG Quest can't finish because of skipping Quest Trigger. 
This problem currently occurs if you go to the crematorium without accepting Quest from UncleG.

[*] Changed the options menu to a simpler format.　Made it easier to adjust.

[*] The car select menu can now be selected only from the keyboard. We plan to improve this.

[*] We have reviewed the quest restrictions and made them easier to accept. Allows the player to choose which quest to take. The story and special quests remain the same.
 
[/list]


Thank you for uploading the video of Death Ration gameplay.
We were able to notice things that we had overlooked.

We appreciate it.

The hotfix version will be uploaded on October 19th.
